reportControlCharacters@PostToolUse.exercise: Any Write under .claude/hookprobe/, which makes the hook emit a live-ness line and then continue into the ordinary scan unchanged. That certifies INVOCATION only. Detection cannot be exercised on demand: its trigger is a byte nobody can author, and a deliberate attempt on 2026-08-23 to write 0x01 and 0x00 through the tool produced two ordinary spaces.
reportControlCharacters@PostToolUse.evidence: The hook emitted its live-ness line on a Write to .claude/hookprobe/live.txt and the harness surfaced it as a PostToolUse blocking error, so the exit 2 and the stderr both reached the agent. Self-certifying: nothing that failed to load the hook can produce the hook's own output, which is why the session's age does not weaken it. INVOCATION only — the scan's correctness is proof:reportControlCharacters.
